goal: A2 authenticated local runtime API and deterministic inspection pipeline
scope: A2 only; A3/Codex execution, provider calls, delivery, workshops, and screen capture are not enabled
implementation: FastAPI exposes authenticated loopback computer routes with constant-time bearer-token comparison; /health is public, CORS is disabled, command bodies and response pages are bounded.

Host configuration controls private data/config/runtime directories, allowed roots, token file, worker limit, adapter argv, timeout, and loopback port. Session tokens are generated or loaded privately and never returned by the API.

Only canonical stored local_git_inspection jobs can run: typed source, candidate.frozen_identity, read_repo/run_checks, no plan, and zero budget. Coding/model capability reports unavailable and unverified.

Scheduler calls B repo.inspect, repo.prepare, and artifacts.freeze, imports and re-hashes immutable manifest/files, then calls D check.run on the exact frozen snapshot and host-staged manifest. Child environments are scrubbed and subprocesses use host-configured argv without a shell.

Status, run events, summary-first artifact metadata, manifest files, UTF-8 text, diff rows, and exact inert attachment content are exposed through bounded authenticated reads. Signed cursors are identity-scoped and reject noncanonical Base64 encodings.

commands.command: Temporary loopback server smoke: health, unauthenticated rejection, authenticated capabilities, project.register, job.create, job.run, status, and first-page artifact metadata
commands.result: Job reached verifying under local_git_inspection, spent_usd=0.0; first artifact page included file_manifest, diff, patch, source_file, and test_report.

fixture_live_distinction: The actual B/D subprocess pipeline and separate loopback-server job used disposable temporary Git fixtures. No configured user repository or product job was changed.
